Use the project's editable `theme.py` for font, color, spacing and timing defaults.

For a real subject with a known look, load sourced art (licenses and access in
the [image sources](../make-motion-graphics/references/image-sources.json)) with
`SVGMobject` to animate its parts, or a raster with `ImageMobject`.

## Voyager integration

- Setup installs a pinned
  private runtime on demand and creates `scenes.py` and `theme.py`. It is retryable,
  preserves edited source, and refuses unrelated nonempty directories.
- To adopt an upstream project, initialize a separate Voyager project and copy the
  required source/assets into it, preserving originals. Do not fabricate the
  compatibility marker or change managed dependencies to repair a scene.
- The wrapper renders one Scene, for example:
  `voyager manim run <project> -- render scenes.py <SceneName> out/draft.mp4`.
  It supports draft/final quality, explicit dimensions/fps, PNG `--still` (the
  Scene's last frame/state), and MOV
  `--transparent`. It does not accept arbitrary upstream/Python commands.
- Call `theme.apply_theme(self)` in `construct()` to apply the project's background
  and text defaults. Inter is bundled; project `fonts/*.ttf` and `fonts/*.otf` are
  registered for Pango text. Source and relative assets resolve from the project.
- Existing outputs are preserved unless `--overwrite` is explicit.
- A foreground wait ending does not end its durable job. Follow
  `voyager jobs wait/status/cancel <id>` instead of starting a duplicate. Progress
  counts observed animation steps, not whole-video frames.

## Non-obvious Manim details

The managed runtime uses Cairo and includes Typst; global Python, compilers, and TeX
are not needed for that path. Prefer `Text` for labels and `MathTypst` for formulas.
`Tex`/`MathTex` need a separate LaTeX toolchain, and
convenience objects can invoke it indirectly: `DecimalNumber` and `NumberLine`
labels default to `MathTex`. Override their text constructors when building a
TeX-free scene: `DecimalNumber(..., mob_class=Text)`, and axis numbers with
`label_constructor=Text` in the axis config.

Typst equations have their own font configuration (`font_paths`, `typst_preamble`);
Pango registration and `Text.set_default` do not style them. For term-level colors
and transformations, MathTypst's labeled groups and `.select()` are more robust
than indexing rendered glyphs.

## References and examples

Match examples to the version reported by `voyager manim status`; ManimGL and
older Community releases differ:

- [MathTypst](https://docs.manim.community/en/stable/reference/manim.mobject.text.typst_mobject.MathTypst.html): semantic equation groups and selection examples.
- [Typst](https://docs.manim.community/en/stable/reference/manim.mobject.text.typst_mobject.Typst.html): font paths, preambles, and rendering options.

For continuous motion, sync or how a clip sounds, use [watch and listen](../make-ai-video/references/understanding.md) (paid upload).
